offerings.name: Search
offerings.pricing: $7 / 1k requests；base price includes up to 10 results. Each result above 10: $1 / 1k results; AI page summaries: $1 / 1k pages.
offerings.price_basis: PAYG /search，基础价格（每请求最多10个结果）
offerings.free_quota: New accounts get $20 in free credits (around 2,800 searches) and the Free Tier adds $10 in credits every month.
offerings.output_type: 实时搜索结果、URL和页面内容；可含 AI summary 和 structured outputs
offerings.note: 可按 fast、auto、deep 搜索类型；最多可返回1,000结果（Enterprise）。

offerings.name: Deep Search
offerings.pricing: deep-lite: $12 / 1k requests; deep: $12 / 1k requests; deep-reasoning: $15 / 1k requests.
offerings.price_basis: PAYG deep-lite / deep，基础价格（每请求最多10个结果）
offerings.free_quota: New accounts get $20 in free credits (around 2,800 searches) and the Free Tier adds $10 in credits every month.
offerings.output_type: 多步骤研究，带 structured outputs and citations
offerings.note: deep-reasoning为$15/1k；额外结果和AI页面摘要与标准搜索同价。

offerings.name: Answer
offerings.free_quota: New accounts get $20 in free credits (around 2,800 searches) and the Free Tier adds $10 in credits every month.
offerings.output_type: An LLM answer to a question, with citations.

offerings.name: Monitors
offerings.pricing: $15 / 1k requests；base price includes up to 10 results. Each result above 10: $1 / 1k results; AI page summaries: $1 / 1k pages.
offerings.price_basis: PAYG /monitors，基础价格（每请求最多10个结果）
offerings.free_quota: New accounts get $20 in free credits (around 2,800 searches) and the Free Tier adds $10 in credits every month.
offerings.output_type: Scheduled searches that surface new events on the web.
